o1: Enables mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of translation and sex determination. Is located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line and gonad. Is part of the sex determination pathway. Orthologous to human RBMS1 (RNA binding motif single stranded interacting protein 1); RBMS2 (RNA binding motif single stranded interacting protein 2); and RBMS3 (RNA binding motif single stranded interacting protein 3).
